name: What is the difference between traditional stucco and synthetic stucco (EIFS)?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between traditional stucco and synthetic stucco (EIFS)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional stucco is made from cement, sand, lime, and water, applied in multiple layers over a wire lath. It's a durable, breathable, and fire-resistant material. Synthetic stucco, or Exterior Insulation and Finish Systems (EIFS), is a multi-layered system that includes insulation board, a base coat with a reinforcing mesh, and a finish coat. EIFS offers superior insulation properties but requires careful installation to prevent moisture intrusion. Each has distinct aesthetic and performance characteristics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional stucco is a cement-based material, while synthetic stucco (EIFS) is a multi-layered system with insulation. Traditional stucco is breathable, and EIFS offers better insulation.
